nodes.label: SemanticEmbeddingStrategy (MiniLM→LSH→Bipolar)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled by default; RandomGenerationStrategy is simpler and fully deterministic. Semantic strategy would improve cross-domain resonance by generating vectors with higher cosine similarity for related entities, but the LSH projection matrix adds ~15MB memory overhead.

nodes.label: Holographic Bypass (Chunk Clean-Up Workaround)
nodes.rationale: Introduced because intermediate chunk clean-up (cleanUpChunk) fails when entities have 30-50 properties; the bundle noise from many branches degrades SNR below the 4.0σ Z-Score threshold at D=10000. Skipping the intermediate clean-up propagates residual noise to the final extraction, reducing overall accuracy.
